_readme: EVERYTHING on the interactive map comes from this one file. See HOW-TO-ADD-A-MARKER.md.
x and y are PERCENTAGES of the base image (x: 0 = left edge, 100 = right edge; y: 0 = top, 100 = bottom).
Percentages mean you can swap the base map image for a bigger/better one without moving a single marker.
status: 'confirmed' = you verified it in-game. 'unverified' = from a community source, shown with a dashed amber ring.
Markers with "source": "gtadb" were imported from the Leonida Atlas / gtadb.org community map (CC BY 4.0). Keep the credit line under the map. Flip one to confirmed only after checking it in-game.
